ED_Title: Zone of peace and cooperation of the South Atlantic
ED_DecisionText: At its 115h plenary meeting, on 4 September 2026, the General Assembly decided to include the item entitled “Zone of peace and cooperation of the South Atlantic” in the draft agenda of the eighty-first session.
ED_Disclaimer: The final text of this decision will be contained in document A/80/49 (Vol. III) after editorial review.
